subject: I wasn't going to share this secret hack with anyone
preview_text: But I built something extra for you. It changes how you'll use Smart Notes forever. Don't skip this.
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. I was testing a new workflow last week, something I built just for my own crazy meeting schedule. It worked so well I almost didn't tell anyone. It felt like a secret weapon I should keep to myself.

The thing is, I built Smart Notes to solve my own problem of missing key points. But this new thing? It solves the problem of what happens AFTER the meeting. It turns your summaries from a record into a roadmap. I wasn't planning to release it, but then I thought—if it helped me this much, you should have it too.

I quietly added it to the app. It's called 'Action Item Tracker.' Open any past meeting summary, and you'll see it. It doesn't just list your tasks. It connects them across meetings, surfaces forgotten commitments, and shows you what's actually moving forward versus what's just... sitting there. It's the feature I didn't know I needed until I built it.

Open Smart Notes right now and pull up your last three meeting summaries. See the new tab. It will show you a pattern you've been missing. Try this now. P.S. This works best if you've had at least 5 meetings in the app. The more it has to work with, the more it will shock you with what you've overlooked.
cta_text: Open Smart Notes & Find the Tracker
